title: OCTOPUS Phase-1 Discovery Evidence Envelope (frozen)
description: Single evidence unit for OCTOPUS multi-model discovery. FROZEN BEFORE PROMPTING so that the Phase-3 merge is a join on field_id, not an editorial comparison. Do not edit field_ids after Kimi/GLM prompting has started; additive changes require a v2 schema.

node.description: Node the fact is ABOUT. BOARD-180 facts are always collected from LAPTOP-191 (board itself is out of scope in D0).

execution_host.description: Node where the command runs. BOARD-180 is never an execution host in D0.

collection_mode.description: P0_PASSIVE: read of state the OS already holds. P1_CAPTURE: packet capture, owner-gated, default forbidden. D0_REMOTE_READ: SSH read-only session, requires one explicit owner authorization. LOCAL_READ_ONLY_TEST: deterministic local check (e.g. structural grep).

command.description: Exact command string. Must contain no shell redirection, no file creation, no scheduler access, no secret printing.

value.description: Measured/observed value. null when status is UNKNOWN/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN_BY_POLICY.

stdout_sha256.description: SHA-256 of raw stdout. Required for status VERIFIED / TEST_VERIFIED; absence forces downgrade to CLAIMED.

stdout_excerpt.description: Max 20 lines, secret-free. Optional convenience copy; the digest is authoritative.

artifact_path.description: Repo-relative path to the full captured output. Required for VERIFIED; absence forces downgrade to CLAIMED.

verification_command_id.description: ID of the command in the merged DISCOVERY-COMMAND-PLAN that produced this. NONE for UNKNOWN_BY_POLICY fields.

alt_command.description: Competing command for the same field_id from the other model. Preserved verbatim, never silently dropped.

source.description: RUNTIME_EVIDENCE is the only source that can carry VERIFIED. Model outputs (single or converged) cap at CLAIMED.

status.description: UNKNOWN: never observed. CLAIMED: asserted (model output, stale doc, repo record) without runtime digest. VERIFIED: runtime artifact + sha256 + timestamp. TEST_VERIFIED: deterministic local read-only test with digest. OWNER_DECISION: owner-authored binding record. BLOCKED: attempted but blocked (record blocker, e.g. BLOCKED_SOURCE_PATH_UNKNOWN). UNKNOWN_BY_POLICY: discoverable but governance forbids (scheduler). CONTRADICTED: two sources of evidence disagree. STALE: was VERIFIED, aged past freshness window. NOT_APPLICABLE: field has no meaning on this node.

field_id.description: FROZEN taxonomy. Join key for the Phase-3 merge. svc.scheduler is permanently UNKNOWN_BY_POLICY with verification_command NONE.
